"Yeh Reshmi Zulfein" is a popular song from the Bollywood movie "Do Raaste" (1969), starring Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz.
Song: Yeh Reshmi Zulfein
Movie: Do Raaste (1969)
Starcast: Rajesh Khanna, Mumtaz, Bindu, Asit Sen, Balraj Sahni & Prem Chopra
Singer: Mohd.Rafi
Music Director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
